title: A Plate Rubbing
author: unsigned
pages: Charcoal on cloth, taken from the breastplate of one of the square ones after it stopped. The marks are cut, not cast.

Read by a scholar of old hands, who was not sure:

KEEP THE DOOR.
ADMIT THE BUILDERS.
ADMIT NO OTHER.
There is a tally under it, scratched later and by something with no hands to speak of. A stroke for each day the builders did not come. It runs off the edge of the plate.
